svg.text: Transcript in, reviewed show notes out. Ingest, agent worker, model and retrieval, storage and human review, with the cross-cutting concerns below. The same container runs locally with docker compose.
ECS Fargate, autoscaled on queue depth. The same Docker image runs locally.
The model decides what to do next; the code executes and checks it.
the model writes a short numbered plan
the model picks the next tool call
accepted, or rejected with the exact fix
until finish; turn budget 30; nudge if it stalls
tool_use down; tool_result back up (accepted, or is_error with the fix)
Guardrails: enforced in code by every submit_* tool
• Summary 200-300 words; exactly 5 takeaways; 3-6 quotes; 4-10 tags
• Every quote verbatim in the line at its timestamp, by the named speaker
• Knowledge base searched before verdicts; verdicts need sources; kb ids must exist
• Predictions and anecdotes are never ✅; recorded counter-evidence blocks ✅
cost per day, p95 run time
SDK retries with backoff; SQS redelivery
Verdicts: ✅ verified true ⚠️ possibly outdated / inaccurate ❓ unverifiable
